name: Facet
notes: First release: iPhone-style folders on your desktop with custom names (drop apps, shortcuts, files and folders in, click to open), always-open panels, a customizable clock (minimal, card, analog or stacked; font, weight, size, colour, date, seconds), frosted glass that matches your wallpaper, Organize Desktop to sort your desktop into folders in one go, and an option to hide the Windows desktop icons.
